page_title: IPTVMac: IPTV Player for Mac, Windows, Android and Android TV (Xtream Codes and M3U)

sources.entry: IPTVMac - Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U with instant search, mpv playback, Picture in Picture and downloads. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Goelir/IPTVMac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: IPTVMac
summary.one_liner: IPTVMac is a free, open source IPTV player for Mac, Android, Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV that plays Xtream Codes and M3U sources you supply.
use_cases: Watching live TV from an IPTV provider on a Mac
Playing an M3U playlist link on a Mac or Android device
Watching IPTV on an Android TV, Google TV or Fire TV box
Watching past programs via catch-up on supported channels
Floating a video window over other apps while browsing
summary.what_it_does: IPTVMac plays Xtream Codes and M3U sources using a built-in mpv player. For Xtream Codes you enter the server address, username and password from your provider; for M3U you enter a name and playlist link. It offers instant search, subtitles, Picture in Picture that stays on top across Spaces, and catch-up on channels where the provider supports it, selected from the guide. The Android version adds downloads for offline viewing, and the interface is available in 31 languages. The page states the app does not include or host any channels and has no accounts or tracking.
notable: Free and open source under GPL-3.0 with no ads or tracking
Supports both Xtream Codes and M3U sources
Built-in mpv playback engine with Picture in Picture
Shares the same engine and languages across Mac, Android and TV versions
caveats: Mac version requires Apple Silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later; Intel Macs are not supported
iPhone and iPad app was still awaiting App Store review; Android TV versions have no store listing yet
Versions before 0.9.1 are not notarized, so macOS blocks them when downloaded in a browser
